jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales (scheme-wide dates for all participating firms)
jobs.notes: Scheme opens 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027 and offers may be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027; the page lists two alternative closing dates (Sun 4 and Sun 11 July, 11:59pm AEST) marked with an asterisk, so a single firm-independent close date cannot be confirmed — check the individual firm's listing. Eligibility: penultimate (or in some cases final) year law students.

Firm's own graduate site states applications for the 2027 First Nations Legal Internship are open and close Monday 2 November 2026; the opening date is not stated on the page so it is left null, and Allens' 2026/27 seasonal clerkship rounds are shown as closed.

jobs.program: Seasonal Clerkship and Graduate Recruitment Scheme (2027 cycle)
jobs.notes: QLS maintains the official Queensland seasonal clerkship and graduate recruitment guidelines that set common open/close/offer dates for participating Brisbane firms, but the 2027-cycle key dates were not confirmable from the live page at the time of checking, so both dates are null rather than guessed.
